title: Grateful Dead Live at St. Paul Civic Center on 1982-08-06
lineage: Cassette (Nakamichi DR-1/Dolby B) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/96k) ->Samplitude Professional v11.2 -> FLAC/16
source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Cassette (Sony TC-D5M/Dolby B/TDK MA-C90)

ai_review.summary: High‑energy 1982 show with scorching Bird Song, Lazy Lightning / Supplication and seamless Scarlet > Fire transitions, captured on a solid‑sounding soundboard recording despite brief patchy moments.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about this August‑6‑1982 performance, highlighting Jerry Garcia’s inspired lead work, monster versions of Bird Song, Lazy Lightning/Supplication, Scarlet/Fire and the Lost Sailor > Saint jam. The Miller SBD is generally clear and well‑balanced, with only minor AUD patches and a subtle vocal echo that many reviewers find adds ambience.

ai_rating.rationale: The majority of reviews praise both the musical performance (standout songs, high energy) and the recording quality (well‑recorded, solid sounding), with only one mixed comment about bass/echo, yielding a strong combined score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Well recorded overall; brief AUD patches are present but not intrusive. Some reviewers note a slight echo on vocals and early‑year bass thinness, but the mix is clear and the ambience works well.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong first set (often cited as one of the finest Brent‑era opens) flows into a high‑energy second set with seamless transitions, especially the Scarlet/Fire and Lost Sailor/Saint pairings.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Excellent playing by Jerry is repeatedly highlighted.
